753:t_179:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's right! You forgot the emotion called love, so how could you understand our dreams and hopes!」

753:t_179:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「The proof is that you can't understand the power that dwells in my wings!」

753:t_179:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's go, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! My wings will surpass the fate you've decreed!」

753:t_179:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm fighting you to protect the ones I love!!」

753:t_180:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, follow me! We take him down and end it all!」

753:t_180:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Good spirit, $$オズマ$$. But it is already too late for everything.」

753:t_180:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You will all be embraced by me, and the end of the universe...」

753:t_180:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I don't have time to listen to your empty talk!」

753:t_180:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Prepare yourself, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'm taking you down to protect the world where I'll live with the woman I love!!」

753:t_181:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ミシェル$$... In the new world, you will be reunited with your sister.」

753:t_181:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「If you think you're saying that out of kindness, then God's focus is way off!」

753:t_181:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The past is the past! My eyes have been fixed on the future for a long time now!」

753:t_181:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am the one who will create that future. Your bodies will perish along with this world!」

753:t_181:4.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's enough, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'm going to shoot that glib tongue of yours right out!!」

753:t_181:5.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I saw the future beyond the target sight! I'm taking my shot, too!!」

753:t_182:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ルカ$$... Relay my data to everyone. Then they will surely resign themselves.」

753:t_182:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「It won't go the way you want. I myself have no intention of backing down, either.」

753:t_182:2.en:
$$ルカ$$
「We have no intention of accepting the result without doing anything...! Whether our opponent is a god or the universe, we'll resist with everything we have until the very last moment!」

753:t_182:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I'm surprised. That a gentle boy like you was hiding such fighting spirit.」

753:t_182:4.en:
$$ルカ$$
「I have someone I want to protect, too! I'm fighting for that person!」

753:t_182:5.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$ナナセ$$! I'll put my life on the line to protect you!」

753:t_183:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「$$ミシェル$$! I'll seize the future together with you! By defeating this monster!」

753:t_183:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then, $$クラン$$... Shall I use my power to send just you and $$ミシェル$$ to the next universe?」

753:t_183:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「Silence, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You, who try to deceive and corrupt people with words like that, are no god, but a devil!」

753:t_183:3.en:
$$クラン$$
「Don't underestimate the Zentradi! I don't want a future handed to me as charity!」

753:t_183:4.en:
$$クラン$$
「The future is something you win, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll fight you with every battle instinct engraved in my genes!!」

753:t_184:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Wait for me, $$エディ$$! Mom will protect you and the universe!」

753:t_184:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「A mother is strong... I can feel your boundless love, $$カナリア$$.」

753:t_184:2.en:
$$カナリア$$
「You can't possibly understand! The feelings of someone who fights for what they protect!」

753:t_184:3.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Vanish, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! A man who loves no one is unworthy of the name of God!!」

753:t_185:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How reckless, $$ブレラ$$. Do you intend to throw away your own life?」

753:t_185:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I've been prepared for a long time...! To protect $$ランカ$$... and the world $$ランカ$$ loves!」

753:t_185:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Unconditional love... That is something I, a god, give.」

753:t_185:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Don't be ridiculous...! A man who accepts the destruction of the universe loves no one!」

753:t_185:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The only thing you love is your own existence! I won't hand our world over to a man like that!!」

753:t_186:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ガムリン$$... If your love were not to be rewarded, could you endure that fact?」

753:t_186:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Don't make me laugh, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Do you think words like that will shake me!」

753:t_186:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then could you answer my question?」

753:t_186:4.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If you want to hear it that badly, I'll tell you!」

753:t_186:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Love is something that asks for nothing in return! You, who can't understand that, have no right to call yourself a god!」

753:t_186:6.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Let's do this, $$ミレーヌ$$! I'll protect the future I share with you... and the songs of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$!!」

753:t_187:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Here I come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! The biggest live show in the universe starts now!!」

753:t_187:1.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「W-wait a second, $$バサラ$$! I bet he has no intention of listening to a song!」

753:t_187:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「He used to be human, too! He's got to have a heart!」

753:t_187:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But my heart does not move. A god must be absolute.」

753:t_187:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Is living such a cramped life any fun?! Throw away your duties and responsibilities, and try living however your heart tells you!」

753:t_187:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「However my heart tells me...」

753:t_187:6.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Did $$バサラ$$'s words reach him...?」

753:t_187:7.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「There's nothing for it but to do this.」

753:t_187:11.en:
$$バサラ$$
「The universe, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, everything! Listen to my song!!」

753:t_187:12.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Burn the flame of life!! Everybody, sing!!」

753:t_188:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Separated from the herd, you have been tormented by anxiety... It must have been hard, $$レド$$.」

753:t_188:1.en:
$$レド$$
「People who can no longer decide things for themselves like that cling to a powerful force...」

753:t_188:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「$$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$ referred to that system as 'God'.」

753:t_188:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That's right. That ultimate being is what I am now.」

753:t_188:4.en:
$$レド$$
「In other words, you're the same as Striker: something unnecessary for humans to live as humans...!」

753:t_188:5.en:
$$レド$$
「No...! You're something we have to defeat in order to live!」

753:t_188:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you will come to know. How reckless a thing you are attempting.」

753:t_188:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「And you will regret it! That you should have spent your remaining time in peace!」

753:t_188:8.en:
$$レド$$
「I won't end up with that kind of regret!」

753:t_188:10.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! This is our last battle!」

753:t_188:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Acknowledged. This unit's mission is to become one with Ensign $$レド$$ and end the final battle in victory.」

753:t_188:12.en:
$$レド$$
「I'm human, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! And I'll prove it by defeating you!」

753:t_188:13.en:
$$レド$$
「That humans can live without clinging to gods!!」

753:t_189:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Beating down, in the sea of stars, some obnoxious man who calls himself a god...」

753:t_189:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Doesn't that feel rather good?」

753:t_189:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That's enough getting carried away, $$ラケージ$$. Your words are unpleasant.」

753:t_189:3.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Naturally. It's a provocation, after all.」

753:t_189:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You don't even fear the existence of a god... You are beyond saving!」

753:t_189:5.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「You look lovelier when you show your emotions openly like that, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! As a reward, I'll smash you to pieces!」

753:t_190:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you wish to start your life over, too, $$宗介$$?」

753:t_190:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There's no need to worry. In the new world I lead, too, I'll let you and $$かなめ$$ reunite, having gained new lives.」

753:t_190:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of asking a man like you to play Cupid!」
